quantile_method: nearest rank; median15th and p95 29th of30; endpoint CPU sum formed within each row before quantiles
limitations: Captured IP bytes include IP lengths in both directions, TLS/HTTP, ACKs and retransmissions only on runner-to-Cloudflare leg; exclude relay-to-origin and Ethernet framing or other unobserved traffic.
Endpoint CPU sum combines Linux sender and Mac receiver-handler CPU time, not joules or equal-speed core work.
Raw/zstd Finish synchronously builds and attempts to retain a DAG, while sparse Finish skips DAG warming; measured CPU difference includes this implementation-policy difference.

Receiver CPU starts after HTTP body read and authentication, covers batch decode, endpoint handling with hashing/reconstruction/publication/graph warming, and reply-frame encoding; excludes HTTP ingress/auth parsing, socket write, relay/cloudflared, and frame-buffer destruction after telemetry is sampled.
All mutation arms include identical useful seed plus one changed-target delivery; cumulative comparisons therefore have matched delivery counts.
Target wall includes input preparation and synchronous transfer through Published plus client/retained-state teardown; fixture generation is separate. Pure network transport time was not isolated.
Prefix DAG expansion and all slow observations are retained; no outlier deletion.
